items.title: Edwards Lifesciences Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Results
items.title_zh: 爱德华生命科学公布 2026 年第二季度业绩:TMTT(经导管二尖瓣/三尖瓣治疗)销售额恒定汇率同比大增 44.8%
items.summary_zh: 爱德华生命科学公布 2026 年第二季度业绩:总销售额 17.4 亿美元(同比 +13.6%,恒定汇率 +12.5%);其中 TAVR(经导管主动脉瓣置换)销售额 12.6 亿美元(+11.3%),TMTT(经导管二尖瓣/三尖瓣治疗,含 PASCAL、EVOQUE、新上市的 SAPIEN M3)销售额 1.959 亿美元,恒定汇率同比大增 44.8%。公司同时披露其外科左心耳夹闭系统 Ecliptis 已获 FDA 批准,并上调全年业绩指引,反映结构性心脏病治疗从以 TAVR 为主向多平台增长转型的行业趋势。
items.summary_en: Edwards Lifesciences reported Q2 2026 total sales of $1.74 billion (+13.6% reported, +12.5% constant currency); TAVR sales were $1.26 billion (+11.3%) while TMTT (transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies — PASCAL, EVOQUE and the newly launched SAPIEN M3) sales reached $195.9 million, up 44.8% at constant currency. The company also disclosed FDA clearance of its Ecliptis surgical left atrial appendage exclusion system and raised full-year guidance, underscoring the industry's shift from a TAVR-centric model toward multi-platform structural heart growth.

items.title: Abbott Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year EPS Guidance
items.title_zh: 雅培公布 2026 年第二季度业绩并上调全年每股收益指引:MitraClip、TriClip 与 Navitor TAVR 平台增长强劲
items.summary_zh: 雅培公布 2026 年第二季度业绩:销售额 126 亿美元,调整后每股收益 1.31 美元,均超市场预期。公司披露其结构性心脏产品线增长强劲,其中 Navitor TAVR 平台 2026 年上半年销售额同比增长 30%,MitraClip 与 TriClip 亦保持强劲增长;公司已于 5 月向 FDA 提交新一代左心耳封堵器 Amulet 360 的申请,预计未来 12 个月内在美国推出该产品及 TactiFlex Duo 消融导管等多款器械。公司同时将 2026 全年调整后每股收益指引上调至 5.45–5.60 美元。
items.summary_en: Abbott reported Q2 2026 sales of $12.6 billion and adjusted EPS of $1.31, both topping estimates. The company said its structural heart portfolio is growing strongly — Navitor TAVR sales were up 30% in the first half of 2026, alongside continued strong growth in MitraClip and TriClip — and highlighted its May 2026 FDA submission for the next-generation Amulet 360 left atrial appendage occluder, with U.S. launches of Amulet 360 and other devices such as the TactiFlex Duo ablation catheter expected over the next 12 months. Abbott raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.45–$5.60.
